description: Add thermostatically controlled electric baseboard supplemental heating to the four perimeter Ground Floor zones (South, East, North, West) in the 4StoreyBuilding model. Do NOT add heating to the core zone. For each perimeter zone, set BASEBOARD-SOURCE to ELECTRIC, BASEBOARD-RATING to 5000 (Btu/hr), and BASEBOARD-CTRL to THERMOSTATIC. These parameters are found within the Zone properties of the Ground Floor HVAC systems. Run the simulation and save the project when complete.
